summary: claude-code reported NS-016 implemented (NOT verified): Water layer shipped in v1.2.0: 67 named water bodies >= 1 km2 (6 lakes, 18 reservoirs, 35 sebkhas, 3 chotts, 5 sea-side lagoons) from OSM 2026-10-16 as an overlay that leaves the nested partitions unchanged. scripts/extract/water.py; Bizerte and El Bibane lagoons cut from the OSM coastline (sea pockets behind channels < 600 m).
